senses.zh_definition: 若原文指历史地名 Sheba：示巴，通常与阿拉伯半岛南部的古代萨巴王国联系起来的专名。
senses.en_definition: If the historical proper name is intended: Sheba, a name associated with the ancient kingdom of Saba in southern Arabia.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada nama tempat bersejarah: Sheba, nama yang dikaitkan dengan kerajaan Saba purba di selatan Semenanjung Arab.
senses.nuances: 此义为有条件的专名解释，不能据此确定输入中小写 sheba 的实际所指；它也可能是人名或其他专名。词性 noun 在此表示专有名词。未核实为 DBP 正式普通词条，因此不标记 official；马来文释义为编辑释义。以下搭配是该专名解释下的示例，不代表已核实的高频搭配。马来文宗教名称表将 Syeba 与英文 Sheba 对应：[名称拼写表](https://www.kitabsucimelayu.org/sites/www.kitabsucimelayu.org/files/uploads/Dafter%20Ejaan%20Nama%20-%20Name%20Spelling%20List%5B1%5D.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Sheba belongs to the world of ancient names rather than productive Malay word formation. In historical discussion, it is associated with Saba in southern Arabia. The archaeological sites around Marib preserve evidence of Sabaean cities, temples and irrigation. This background explains a possible reference, but does not establish the identity of the supplied lowercase token. [UNESCO archaeological evaluation](https://whc.unesco.org/archive/2023/whc23-18extcom-INF.5-en.pdf).
